# Bꜣstt at work: pet care & animal industries, home, hearth & real estate, and the myths that got there first
Archetypes are not metaphors; they are job descriptions written early. **Bꜣstt**'s was unusually clear.

Bastet's myths are fewer than those of Isis or Horus, but her role in the solar cycle is vivid: she is the gentle dawn that follows the lioness's night.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **3 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Bꜣstt
- **Pantheon:** Egyptian
- **Domain of influence:** Home, Fertility, Cats
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Home & Lifestyle
- **Strongest seat:** Pet Care & Animal Industries
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 51 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Eye of Re Returns.** In the mythology of the Distant Goddess, the solar eye — often in leonine form — leaves Egypt for Nubia in anger.  Re sends Thoth or Shu to coax her back. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

**Bastet and Apep.** As a daughter of Re, Bastet takes part in the nightly battle against Apep, the serpent of chaos.  In her lioness form she rips at the enemy; in her cat form she watches the prow of the sun barque, guarding Re with sharp eyes. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Pet Care & Animal Industries

*Pet products, veterinary care, and animal brands. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

*She of the ointment jar and the household cat; pet culture’s oldest deity.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Bꜣstt performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Home, Hearth & Real Estate

*Property, home goods, and domestic services. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Home and domestic blessing; the household’s protector.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Beauty, Fashion & Cosmetics

*Cosmetics, fashion, and personal care. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

*She of the ointment jar; perfume and cosmetics are in her name.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Bꜣstt performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Bastet's myths are fewer than those of Isis or Horus, but her role in the solar cycle is vivid: she is the gentle dawn that follows the lioness's night. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.

If you work in pet care & animal industries, home, hearth & real estate, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/bastet/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
